name: kitchen
description: Shared-kitchen MCP server on Cloudflare Workers + D1: recipes, a shared grocery list, and context notes for every member's cook bot.

scripts.typecheck: cf workers types && tsc && tsc -p scripts

KITCHEN_ADMIN_SECRET.description: Secret that unlocks the `create_kitchen` tool. Use a long random string (e.g. `openssl rand -base64 32`) and keep it private; anyone with it can create kitchens on your server.
